Commentary.Commentary: We are back for Australia's reply. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma are the openers of India. Megan Schutt to start with the ball.
...THE RUN CHASE...

India Women showed a spirited effort on the field. There was not once but a couple of incredible stuff from India on the field. They were absolutely brilliant in the field. Talking about their bowling - India used the slower balls really well to take the wickets. It helped them to decieve the opposition and they got the reward as well. Now then, this is a par total and Indian batters are in fine form. The likes of Smriti Mandhana and Harmanpreet Kaur need to show their experience and need to keep their nerves in the final to chase this down. It will not be easy but need to take it deep. Join us back for the chase after the break.

It is very hard to say who will be happy at this innings break as Australia Women have done well to post a competitive total. It was all possible due to Beth Mooney's wonderful fifty. She had to work hard as runs were hard to buy on. Mooney stitched a stand with Lanning at top and later with Gardner. Australia Women needed a good finish and it was given by Rachael Haynes. Australia have a good score and they will bet on the bowlers to defend this.

Phewww...What an eventful innings that was! Australia Women have done well to post a par total but India Women, on the other hand, have been exceptional on the field and that has clearly made a few runs difference.

Rachael Haynes takes couple of runs from the last delivery and that means that Deepti Sharma has given away just 5 runs in the last over! This is fuller on leg. Rachael Haynes sweeps and sweeps it well towards the fine leg region. The batters take two as the fielder cuts it off in the deep. Australia Women finish with 161/8 after 20 overs!
Deepti Sharma bowls it on middle. Megan Schutt swings hard but gets only a single to deep mid-wicket.
Skips down the track and yorks herself again. Rachael Haynes digs it out towards the off side and takes a single this time.
Nails a yorker, on off. Rachael Haynes only manages to dig it out to covers.

OUT! RUN OUT! Another brilliant piece of fielding by India, this time it is from Smriti Mandhana! This is pushed quicker, around off. Jess Jonassen punches it just wide of mid off and looks for a quick single. However, Smriti Mandhana is quick to collect the ball and fires a direct hit at the bowler's end. Jess Jonassen puts in a dive to make her ground but is short as the replays confirm it.
A run out appeal! A direct hit from Smriti Mandhana and Jess Jonassen is run out. Easy decision for the third umpire.
Deepti Sharma pulls her length back as she sees Rachael Haynes advancing. Rachael Haynes hits it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slow over rate! India Women have to bring an extra fielder inside the ring as they have failed to finish the innings inside the given time.
This is pushed quicker on middle. Rachael Haynes skips down the track and works it to deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! Ohh...just away from the diving fielder in the deep! This is on middle. Rachael Haynes skips down the track and heaves it aerially towards the deep mid-wicket region. The fielder in the deep runs away to her riight and dives to catch it. The ball falls away from her and goes away for a boundary.
Tossed up, on middle. Jess Jonassen works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Jess Jonassen walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! India Women are finishing well here! This is tad shorter on off. King heaves it flat and hard but straight to the mid-wicket fielder. Meghna Singh takes a sharp catch and Australia Women are losing their way here.
Commentary.Howout: c Meghna Singh b Radha Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: Pushed quicker on middle. King skips down the track and hits it back to the bowler.
A flatter delivery and outside off. King looks to push it away but misses.
Bowls it over full on off. King digs it out towards extra-cover for a single.
This is quicker and outside off. King looks to cut it but misses.
Goes fuller on off. Rachael Haynes drives it to long off for a single.
SIX! Rachael Haynes deposits the next ball after the wicket over the fence! Tossed up on off. Rachael Haynes dances down the track and launches it over long on for a maximum.
Alana King walks out.

OUT! CAUGHT! Deepti Sharma pulls off a one-handed stunner now! India have been brilliant in the field so far and are now rewarded with a big wicket of Beth Mooney! She dances down the track and Rana very cleverly bowls it a tad short and around off. Beth Mooney still goes through her slog. The ball goes towards the long on region. It goes high in the air as well and Sharma at mid on runs behind and takes it with her right hand diving behind.
Commentary.Howout: c Deepti Sharma b Sneh Rana

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Lovely placement! This is tossed up and outside off. Beth Mooney skips down the track and plays an inside-out shot towards wide long off for a boundary.
On a length and slower in pace. Rachael Haynes works it towards the leg side. Renuka Singh finishes a brilliant spell!
Goes very full and outside off. Rachael Haynes digs it out to long off and comes back for the second run. Good running!
Goes fuller and on the pads. Beth Mooney clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Short and wide outside off. Beth Mooney punches it to sweeper cover for a couple.

OUT! TAKEN! Grace Harris now gets undone by the pace of the ball. This is slow, full and on middle. Harris is too early as she swings her bat across. The ball goes high in the air and to mid on where Meghna Singh takes the skier sharply tracking back.
Commentary.Howout: c Meghna Singh b Renuka Singh

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and outside off, dabbed to short third man.
On middle and tad shorter. Grace Harris pushes it to long off for a single.
WIDE! This is pushed quicker well outside off. Grace Harris leaves it alone.
Goes fuller on off. Beth Mooney drives it to long off for a single.

FOUR! Beth Mooney powers it away for a bounday and gets to her fifty in style! This is a tossed up delivery, around off. Beth Mooney skips down the track and hammers it down the ground for a boundary.
Tossed up, outside off. Beth Mooney drives it to point.
Short and wide outside off. Grace Harris cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Grace Harris comes in next.

OUT! STUMPED! Sneh Rana outfoxes Ashleigh Gardner and India have another big wicket! This one is nicely tossed up, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner dances down the track and looks to slog it away. However, he misses it as the ball comes way slower than she anticipated. Taniya Bhatia collects the ball and whips the bails off in flash as Ashleigh Gardner is well out of her crease.
Commentary.Howout: st Taniya Bhatia b Sneh Rana

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter, slower and outside off. Gardner punches it through covers for a single.
One more as Mooney drills this full ball to long on.
Australia are working in singles at the moment! On middle, it is hit to long on for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Mooney skips down and works it to long on for a single.
Full and on off, Gardner works it through covers for a single.
SIX! That is a thunderous shot! Tossed up outside off. Gardner comes down the track and thumps it high over long on for a huge six.
A single as this is driven to long off.
Tossed up, outside off. Gardner shuffles across and tries to heave but misses. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly. The replay shows there was a bottome edge.
Flatter ball, outside off, worked to point.
Fuller ball, outside off. Gardner drives it to long off, in the gap for two more.
Slightly short and outside off. Mooney gets back in her crease and plays it to point for one.
Shorter and way outside off. Gardner cuts it to deep point for one.
FOUR! Angling on the pads. Mooney sweeps it past short fine leg for a boundary.
Floated ball, outside off. Mooney drives it right of long off for a couple.
Full and outside off, pushed to the right of the bowler.
Angles a length ball on off. Mooney cuts it to deep point and Pooja Vastrakar does the sweeping work. Two.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Fuller and outside off. Mooney skips down and drives it to deep cover for a single. 100 up for Australia Women.
Sneh Rana is back on.

A flatter and outside off. Mooney punches it to point and calls for a quick single. The fielder there fumbles to collect but then collects it quickly and hits the direct-end to the keeper's end but Gardner was in.
Sharma gives width again. This is cut to deep point for a single.
EDGED AND FOUR! Fortunate for Gardner! Flatter and outside off. Gardner tries to drive it but gets an outside edge. This time very fine to the third man fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Flatter and outside off. Gardner tries to cut but gets a thick edge to third man for a boundary.
Outside off, cut to deep point for a couple.
Ashleigh Gardner is the next batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Radha Yadav again shows her skills. What a game she is having. This is just brilliant from Yadav! Sharma drops it short and outside off. McGrath cuts it hard but uppishly and to backward point. Radha Yadav had some work to do as she dives to her left and takes it away from her body. The ball was dying but she did really well to stretch her arms.
Commentary.Howout: c Radha Yadav b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Deepti Sharma is back into the attack. She went for 8 runs in her first over!
Tossed up, outside off, drifting in. McGrath pushes it to covers for a single.
Full and on off. McGrath skips down and eases it straight to mid on.
Tossed up on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for one more.
Tahlia McGrath is off the mark as she hits this full ball to long off.
Full and on middle, eases to long on for a single.
Tahlia McGrath walks out to the middle.

OUT! LANNING IS RUN OUT! That was quick reflexes from Yadav! Flighted ball on off. Mooney pushes it bak to the bowler. Lanning meawhile was out of her crease and had to rush back. Yadav flicks the ball back, through her legs without looking and the replay shows she might have just done something exceptional for her team. OUT shows the big screen. Lanning failed to get her bat down. What a way to get rid of Lanning. It needed something special and Yadav has come up with some superb stuff.

Taniya Bhatia still seems to have been struggling with the blow she got earlier in the game. The physio is out and after the treatment she has decided to continue. Also, Radha Yadav is back into the attack.

FOUR! So, 17 runs off the over! Australia Women have all the momentum here! Harmanpreet Kaur thought she will go away with one over but gives away too many runs! Again short from Kaur, on leg. It is pulled through square leg for four.
FOUR! Make it 13 off five balls! Too full this time, around off. Lanning gets underneath it well and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
FOUR! Kaur is proving expensive! this one is on the pads. Lanning flicks it past short fine leg. The fielder gives a chase but to no avail. Four.
Around off, swept to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Loosener! Drops it short and on middle. Mooney clears her front leg and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for four.
Flatter and on off, punched to covers.
Two runs! Around off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
This is short and outside off. Lanning slashes at it but misses. Lanning thinks she missed out here.
FOUR! poor fielding! A slower ball, full and on the pads. Lanning whacks it to fine leg. The fielder runs to her right, dives but over the ball and it races into the fence.
Outside off, guided to third man for a single.

Tahlia McGrath was tested positive for Covid-19! She is sitting away from her teammates at the moment with her mask on but has been approved to play this game. This was actually the reason why we had a delayed toss in this game.
FOUR! Wonderful shot! Short of a length and on middle. Mooney pulls it brilliantly over mid-wicket for a boundary. The stands between these two crosses the 50-run mark.
A length ball, around off, nips a bit back in. Lanning looks to push but gets an inside edge and it rolls to point. A quick is taken.
Pushes it wide of off. Lanning works it to sweeper cover for a single.
Quicker one, full and on off, Lanning hits it straight to mid off.
Outside off, played to backward point for just a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Flighted ball, full and on off. Mooney gets low and thumps it straight down for four. Both mid on and mid off were up.
Shorter and outside off, bit of width. Lanning cuts it to deep point for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Mooney pushes it through covers for a single.
Sneh Rana is into the attack now.
Around off, pushed to covers. Good over by Yadav. The slower balls are working for India.
Tossed up, around off. Lanning sweeps but finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
On middle, played back to the bowler.
Good stop by Shafali Verma! Floated ball, outside off, it is driven to mid off. Verma dives to her right and makes a solid stop. One.
Flatter and outside off. Lanning cuts it to deep point for one.
Flighted full, outside off, driven to long on for one.
Taniya Bhatia has been hit on the side of her helmet! The physio is out for the mandatory concussion test. She is getting some treatment now and looks fine to continue.

FOUR BYES! A length ball, outside off. Lanning looks to drive but misses. The ball bounces and hits the keeper on the side of the helmet. She gets down in pain as the ball goes to the third man fence.
SIX! LAUNCHED! Sing serves a juicy half-volley, around off. Lanning hangs back and smashes it over long off. Six.
Very full and on off. Mooney pushes it to deep mid-wicket for one.
On a length and outside off, cut to deep point for a single.
A crowd catch! This is full and outside off. Lanning punches it to cover. The crowd thinks that is out but it clearly came on a bounce.
This is full and on middle, whipped to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Keeps it a tad short and flatter around off. Meg Lanning cuts it to the point fielder.

FOUR! Jemimah Rodrigues mistimes her dive in the deep and that allows the ball to run away towards the fence. Deepti Sharma has been bowling short in this over and it another one of those shorter in length delivery, outide off. Meg Lanning slaps it off the back foot towards the deep extra-cover region where Jemimah Rodrigues comes running in towards her right. She dives and tries to stop it but the ball goes past her for a boundary.
On the shorter side again and around off. Beth Mooney cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Tad shorter in length and around off. Meg Lanning punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Bowls it a bit quicker and it is outside off. This is a natural variation of the off-spinner as the ball skids off the surface. Meg Lanning looks to cut but misses.
On the shorter side, outside off. Beth Mooney cuts it to deep point for a single.
WIDE! Floats this up but ends up bowling it way too wide outside off. Beth Mooney looks to get her bat on it but misses.
Back of a length, on middle. Beth Mooney works it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! One cannot bowl any loose deliveries to these Australian batters. It is a full delivery on the pads. Beth Mooney flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
On a length, on off. Beth Mooney drives it straight to mid off.
Follows the yorker with a bouncer. On leg and Beth Mooney pulls it towards the fine leg region. The batters run two as the fielder cuts it off.
Wow! Bowls a yorker on middle. Meg Lanning digs it out to covers for a single.
Goes fuller, around off. Meg Lanning drives it to cover-point. The fielder there dives to her left and stops it.
On a length, on off. Beth Mooney defends it with the angled blade towards point.
FOUR! Nicely played! This is a full toss, on off. Poor delivery and Beth Mooney drives it right of diving Shafali Verma at mid off for a boundary.
On a length, around off. Meg Lanning pushes it to covers for a single.
On a length and outside off. Meg Lanning looks to cut it but misses.
Meg Lanning is the next batter in.

OUT! LBW! An appeal for an LBW but the umpire is not interested. India Women take the review! The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows no bat involved. The Ball Tracking rolls and it shows three reds! The decision will be overturned! It is OUT! This one lands on a good length, on off and comes back in sharply. Healy looks to clip it away but misses. The ball hits her pads and India get their first breakthrough after they make a great decision of taking the DRS.
Lands on a length, on off. Healy defends it off the front foot. This has been a good disciplined start from the Indian bowlers.
Back of a length, outside off. Beth Mooney skips down the track and cuts it to the point fielder. Good stop there!
Goes fuller again, on off. Healy drives it back to the bowler. Meghna Singh fails to collect it cleanly and the ball goes mid off. A single taken.
A very full delivery with a hint of away swing, It is outside off and Healy drives it to the short cover fielder.
Goes fuller on the pads. Beth Mooney clips it to deep square leg for a single. Beth Mooney is off the mark straightaway!
A misfield allows a single this time! On a good length and around off. Healy defends it towards point. The fielder there runs forward and looks to collect it but fumbles it and a single is taken.
Short and wide outside off. Alyssa Healy cuts it to the point fielder.
Meghna Singh to start from the other end.
Back of a length, on middle. Healy works it to deep square leg for a single. Good start from Renuka Singh!

FOUR! Here we go... Alyssa Healy gets the first boundary of the game! However, it is a chance created by Singh as she finds the edge of the blade. It is on a good length and around off. Healy looks to push it away but gets the thick outside edge. The ball flies away from the widish slip for a boundary.
Gets back to that good length again, on off. Alyssa Healy blocks it off the front foot.
WIDE! Back of a length and angling down leg. Alyssa Healy looks to pull it but misses.
Goes a tad fuller, on off. Healy looks to clip it towards the leg side but gets the leding edge that falls just short of the short cover fielder.
Serves it on a good length again, close to off again. Alana King blocks it out again.
Renuka Singh starts off with a length delivery, on off. Bit of shape into the batter and Alyssa Healy defends it off the front foot.

The two on-field umpires walk out to the middle now. The Indian Women players follow them with firecrackers in the background. They are in the huddle now and disperse to their respective positions after some last-minute instructions by their skipper. Alyssa Healy and Beth Mooney, the two dangerous Australian openers are in the middle as well. Renuka Singh to start with the ball. Here we go...

Outwalk the match officials! They are followed by the two teams as they line-up for the national anthems. It will be Australia's anthem first followed by the Indian national anthem. These national anthems always give you goosebumps and it is surely a proud moment for the players of both teams to line-up and sing their national anthem in front of packed crowd.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the skipper of India Women says that the toss is not controllable and they are happy to do anything and it is a great oppotunity to chase. Tells that it is important to play well and it is a very big game and they would look to enjoy themselves. Mentions that the crowd is always behind them and they are excited for the game.

Meg Lanning, the skipper of Australia Women says that they will bat first and adds that it looks like a good pitch and the atmosphere is great. Tells that they were reasonably good in the semi-final and they need to fill some patches. Mentions that it feels like a big game and they have won the finals before but need to play well in this game.

India Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Deepti Sharma, Pooja Vastrakar, Sneh Rana, Taniya Bhatia (WK), Radha Yadav, Meghna Singh, Renuka Singh.

Australia Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Alyssa Healy (WK), Beth Mooney, Meg Lanning (C), Tahlia McGrath, Rachael Haynes, Ashleigh Gardner, Grace Harris, Jess Jonassen, Alana King, Megan Schutt, Darcie Brown.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Meg Lanning. Australia Women have elected to BAT first.
We should have been done with the toss by now, however the news coming out is that it has been delayed a bit. It will not be a big delay and we shall be ready for the toss soon.
